Name: calcXFrameLength
Expression: calcXRailLength + floor(( YFrameWidth + YRollerWidth + XRailtoYRollerLeftGap + XRailtoYRollerRightGap ) / 5) * 5
Comments: Calculation parameter. Changes will cause design failures, alter at your own risk.

Name: calcYFrameLength
Comments: Calculation parameter. Changes will cause design failures, alter at your own risk.

Name: XFrameCount
Expression: max(3; ceil(( calcYFrameLength - XFrameBackOffset - XFrameFrontOffset - XFrameWidth ) / ( 250 mm + XFrameWidth )))
Comments: Info: This can be changed to a set value if more or less XFrame tubing are desired.

Name: calcXRailLength
Expression: ( SRF * ceil(( XCuttingArea + 65 mm + ( ( XCarriageCount * 50 ) * 1 mm ) ) / SRF) )
Comments: Calculation parameter. Changes will cause design failures, alter at your own risk.

Name: calcYRailLength
Expression: ( SRF * ceil(( YCuttingArea + 65 mm + ( ( YCarriageCount * 50 ) * 1 mm ) ) / SRF) )
Comments: Calculation parameter. Changes will cause design failures, alter at your own risk.
